contract: Native AgentCore Lambda argument-map input; tool in client_context.custom.bedrockAgentCoreToolName, exact thundermail___ prefix

tools.name: imap_list_mailboxes
tools.description: List owner mailboxes, sorted lexicographically. Cursor is a JSON-encoded last mailbox name, not a snapshot. No account/host selector.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor returned by previous result; validated before secret lookup

tools.name: imap_search_messages
tools.description: Search EXAMINE-only mailbox using all or unseen. Returns mailbox/UIDVALIDITY/UID identifiers, newest UID first. Bounded transfer may fail closed on very large search results. Cursor has no cold-start memory dependency; not an immutable mailbox snapshot.

mailbox.description: At most 256 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters

cursor.description: Returned cursor binds mailbox/query/UIDVALIDITY/UID upper boundary; stale validity fails

tools.name: imap_get_message
tools.description: Read a bounded raw source prefix with BODY.PEEK[] only. Does not MIME-decode or read attachments. raw_utf8 uses lossy UTF-8 decoding. PEEK rejection fails, never falls back to BODY[] or SELECT.

mailbox.description: At most 256 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters

max_bytes.description: 128 KiB final result ceiling includes duplicate structured/text output and JSON escaping; reduce if exceeded

tools.name: caldav_list_events
tools.description: List events on the owner's default Thundermail calendar that overlap a UTC range, sorted by start. Recurring events are expanded when the server supports CalDAV expand; otherwise the master event includes rrule. Values ending in Z are UTC, values with start_tzid/end_tzid are local to that zone, and 8-digit values are all-day dates.

start.description: Range start, RFC 3339 UTC, for example 2026-10-17T00:00:00Z

end.description: Range end, RFC 3339 UTC, after start
